answer: The velvet lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the karst is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. By the ridge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
